infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LR-Ride needs your location to show nearby drivers and navigate your ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: LR-Ride uses your location in the background to track active rides.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LR-Ride uses the camera to let you upload a profile photo or scan documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LR-Ride needs photo library access to let you choose a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: LR-Ride optionally reads contacts to let you quickly add emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: LR-Ride sends ride status alerts and driver arrival updates via notifications.
